**What was wrong with the original formula:** `VLOOKUP(G2,A2:B8,1,0)` was searching for the session ID in column A (the *Name* column), because VLOOKUP always looks up in the first column of the range. The session IDs live in column B, so the lookup was missing and returning `#N/A`.

**The working solution I applied** in `F2:F5` uses INDEX/MATCH to look up the session ID (in column B) and return the corresponding Name (column A):

```
=INDEX(A2:A8,MATCH(G2,B2:B8,0))
```

This correctly produces the agent name for each pass session listed in column G:

| F2 | John |
| F3 | Paulie |
| F4 | Sandy |
| F5 | Stevey |
